events.about:
We organize monthly open mics where you can come and perform your stories and pieces. It will be like a little warm home for your words, and a place for our community to bond, give and receive feedback, and have a beautiful time overall
How the open mic works:
1) Get tickets, come to the venue
2) Put your name in the hat lying on the stage if you wish to perform (if you want to come and only listen, you are welcome with open arms and heart)
3) Our host will pick 10 people during the show at random who will get to perform at the event
4) You will get a 5-minute slot to perform a story (fiction/non-fiction) or a poem
5) We will declare a performer of the night at the end of every session.

An enchanting live jamming session with Harmonium, Tabla and multiple instruments where around 20 talented artists come together to create magic on stage. Feel the energy of real-time jugalbandi and spontaneous musical moments.

Sit back as an audience or step up as a performer. Either way, you will leave with unforgettable memories.
Every performer receives a special gift as a token of appreciation.
Warm, friendly and aesthetic environment.
Perfect place to express, connect and unwind.
Limited passes available. Book now and be a part of this magical baithak!

events.about:
The mind seeks familiarity over newness, and family becomes our first place of comfort and safety. But what if this familiarity is shaped by pain? What if the same patterns repeat in every relationship, mistaken for security? Science says genes and cells never truly die. They live on through generations. But what if, beyond biology, it is the social structure that shapes us? This is a story of generations, of long suppressed truths, of wounds conceived as love. Come, let`s bid a farewell to all the dramas and traumas inherited, carried forward, and lived through generations.
Note - The performance includes one interval.
Please note - Strictly no late entry will be permitted.

Come, celebrate the tradition. Feel the energy. Dance your heart out at Sindhu Maharas Garba Mahotsav 2026!
